01 — 04 / CONCEPT WORK

Sonnet Print Poster

A visual exploration of form, tone, and rhythm. Crafted as a study in minimalist balance.

Branding & Identity
An experimental visual identity built around a single sculptural form. The glass-bead artwork explores how a repeated material can become a recognizable visual language.

02 — 04 / CONCEPT WORK

Smart Earbuds App

An audio experience designed for clarity, confidence, and seamless usability.

UI/UX · Product Design
A concept for an audio companion, with a clear hierarchy for listening, device status, and everyday controls. This portfolio entry is an illustrative case study, not a working audio app.

03 — 04 / CONCEPT WORK

Shopping App

A shopping experience that turns a world of possibilities into a considered selection.

UI/UX · Development
A playful exploration of a shopping identity through tactile color and modular forms. The blocks stand for a flexible visual system; no shopping or checkout service is connected.

04 — 04 / CONCEPT WORK

Fibespace Studio

Brand and packaging design rooted in simplicity. Color, rhythm, and a little room to play.

Branding & Identity
A compact music studio identity inspired by the satisfying tactility of analog instruments. Warm color, precise geometry, and an expressive image system give the concept its character.
